site.name: Coordenada Geo
site.tagline: Specialised geospatial technology for land, rural production and the environment
site.description: Coordenada Geo is a specialised geospatial-technology company: a web platform for origin traceability and socio-environmental compliance, plus remote sensing, geoprocessing and bespoke solution development — turning spatial data into decisions about land, production and the environment.

hero.eyebrow: For those who decide about land, production and the environment
hero.title: Geographic data turned into applicable knowledge
hero.subtitle: We combine a web platform with solutions for territorial and environmental management with specialised remote sensing and geoprocessing services. Ideal for those who produce on the land, care for the environment and decide about the territory, from assessment to operation.

about.title: Specialists in building solutions that integrate geographic data using information technology.
about.body: Coordenada Geo works at the interface of technology and geographic data. The demand for quality and transparency has grown: new rules for credit, exports and markets now require proof of origin and socio-environmental compliance. We help those who produce on the land, care for the environment and decide about the territory operate with precision — delivering value in two complementary ways: a web platform that makes traceability and compliance accessible and practical, and specialised remote sensing, geoprocessing and bespoke development services for challenges that go beyond what is already available on the platform.
bullets: A modular platform with ready-made services for common problems.
Bespoke modules for complex, customised solutions.
Scientific rigour when choosing data, methods and validations, with iterative delivery.
An explicit social-environmental commitment: transparency for people, territories and ecosystems.

purpose.title: Applied knowledge for conscious decisions about the territory
purpose.body: To turn geographic data into applied knowledge: to make the origin of agricultural products and their socio-environmental compliance verifiable and accessible, and decisions about the territory more conscious — with technical rigour, in favour of more conscious consumers, more transparent markets and more protected ecosystems.

items.title: Precision
items.body: Technical and scientific rigour when choosing methods, data and validations, without sacrificing clarity in the results.

items.title: Collaboration
items.body: We build solutions close to the client, integrating technical and domain expertise.

items.title: Adaptation
items.body: We tailor each solution, scope, tools and deliverables to the reality of each client and project.

items.title: Revitalisation
items.body: We prioritise initiatives that generate positive impact on people, ecosystems and territories.

platform.title: Create reports with spatial analysis and valuable insights about your territory of interest.
platform.body: Our platform simplifies the analysis of productive territories to deliver the answers needed to secure your operation. You indicate your areas of interest (polygons of rural properties, farmland plots and production areas) and the platform cross-references them with the datasets that matter: deforestation alerts, areas embargoed by IBAMA, conservation units, indigenous lands and other protected areas. Results are delivered in customisable reports, with the overlaps analysed, history and data provenance in an auditable record — ready to prove origin in audits and meet credit, export and consumer-market requirements. Each organisation has its own isolated environment, with APIs to integrate with your procurement and operations process.

services.title: When the problem calls for a bespoke solution
services.intro: Our platform offers solutions for challenges common to the market. For specific problems, we work end to end — from assessment and planning to execution and operation — with validated methods for remote sensing, geoprocessing and software development projects.

items.title: Applied remote sensing
items.body: Analysis of satellite imagery sets for detecting changes in land use and land cover, deforestation and regeneration, burn scars, water resources and environmental liabilities.

items.title: Geoprocessing and spatial analysis
items.body: Geographic data modelling, spatial analysis and geostatistics, combining multimodal datasets to answer complex questions about the territory.

items.title: Dashboards and visualisation
items.body: Building interactive maps and web dashboards to track indicators, areas of interest and time series of geographic data.

items.title: Automation and data pipelines
items.body: Automations, geospatial ETL, API integration and pipelines to orchestrate the collection, processing and publishing of geographic data.

items.title: Bespoke geospatial platforms and APIs
items.body: Development of geospatial web applications and APIs, from concept to production operation.

items.title: Training and technical support
items.body: Training and mentoring for teams working on development that combines remote sensing, geographic data and geoprocessing.

items.title: Rural production and supply chains
items.body: Origin traceability, supplier verification and meeting credit, export and market requirements.

items.title: Environment and climate
items.body: Deforestation and regeneration, vegetation cover, protected areas, environmental liabilities and risk. Estimates of greenhouse gas emissions and removals from land use and land cover change.

items.title: Territory and land use
items.body: Characterisation of rural properties, land use and occupation dynamics, regularisation and CAR status.

items.title: Public sector and infrastructure
items.body: Inputs for planning and territorial policy, programme monitoring and analysis of assets and networks.
